{"title":"Austin hiking communities research (groups, trails, online hubs)","content":"## Plan
Gather high-quality, current options for Austin, TX hiking/outdoor communities suited to a 32-year-old by researching in parallel across (1) formal clubs/nonprofits and retailers, (2) Meetup-based hiking groups, (3) online communities (Reddit/Facebook/Discord), and (4) the most common local trails used for group hikes (including logistics like parking/permits). Then synthesize into a single curated list with links, what to expect, and how to join.

## Deliverable
A structured report with:
- **Best groups/clubs** (name, link, vibe/age fit, typical events, cost/dues, safety/skill level)
- **Meetup picks** (most active + best-reviewed, typical hike locations, cadence)
- **Online communities** (subreddits, Facebook groups, Discord/Slack if available; activity level + joining notes)
- **Popular group-hike trails** (why popular, route options, distance/terrain, parking/permit/seasonal water notes)
